notes:
- **The Pro list has Trim videos.** Settings › Pro and the Pro sheet now list **Trim videos** ("Cut the start and end off a recording and save it as a new file. The original stays.") as its own line, in the same words as a9snap.com, with a How to use link to the manual. Pressing Trim in A9 View without Pro opens the sheet for Trim, not for Video and GIF capture. Trim itself is unchanged.
- **a9snap.com says what is new.** The home page has a new **A9 View** section (open a picture or a video at a sensible size, wheel through the folder, Ctrl+wheel zoom with a mini-map, the thumbnail strip, the info panel, play MP4, M4V, MOV and WebM videos, save a frame; free) with a picture of the real window on generated content, and the Pro section, the FAQ and the manual's Pro page list **Trim videos** and count ten Pro features. The site's drift check now covers Trim too, so the page and the app can't disagree about it.
- **A Store rating card, for the Microsoft Store version only.** After 7 days of use and 20 captures, one small card in Home asks "Enjoying A9 Snap? A rating in the Microsoft Store helps other people find it." with **Rate** (Windows' own rating dialog, or the Store review page if Windows can't show it), **Not now** (asks once more after 30 days, then never) and **Don't ask again**. It never shows while you capture or in the 10 minutes after one, is never a pop-up over other apps, and appears at most twice ever. The copy installed from a9snap.com never counts, asks or shows it. The first day and the capture count are kept in `rating.json` beside your settings and never leave your PC; the log says only that the card was shown or how it was answered.
- **Rate A9 Snap in the Microsoft Store.** On the Store version, the version line in the left-hand column and the version row on **Updates and about** have a **Rate A9 Snap in the Microsoft Store** link. It is always there and counts nothing.
- **Left out for now: Suggest a feature.** A link to a feedback page needs a published support address, and the app and the site publish none yet, so there is no such item in the tray or in Settings.
- **Manual and privacy.** The manual's Pro page, the A9 View page links, Updates and channels, the Home window page and the privacy page describe all of this.
- **Tests.** The rating rule has unit tests (days, captures, Store or not, Not now, Don't ask again, the two-ask cap, never right after a capture); `scripts/e2e/rating.mjs` drives the real app with a test hook for the install type and the counts.
